meta.title: dsh remote go
meta.description: Use a remote DSH over SSH inside the local DSH: the desktop client fills the whole window with the remote UI, and one host switcher sits at the top of the sidebar in both the local page and the remote one — it lists “Local” plus every remote host, and picking one switches the window to it. Connected remotes carry a glowing green dot; picking a host that is not up floats its connect window — staged progress on top and that connection’s log underneath (SSH, npx, the remote launch), scrolling and following new lines; “Add host” and “Manage hosts” are the last entries, both floating over the page (a remote stays behind them): adding a host is one form with “Save” (record only) and “Connect” (save and go), and coming back to a warm remote is instant. The plugin installs its own Node under ~/.dsh/remote-go/node at the lower bound of DSH engines.node (never the system one), then launches the remote DSH with npx pinned to the local version; its data stays in the user’s own ~/.dsh. Diagnostics and exact version parity included.
